_readme: Level 1 reward rules. Change any number here; it applies on the next Play.
passingPercent: the share of the level's maximum EXP AND maximum hearts needed to pass (unlock the next level). 100 = perfect run required.

requireSideQuestBeforeOffice: true = the office entrance doors stay shut (and block the way in) until the side quest is finished, then swing open; the receptionist, desk and case cannot be used before that either.
officeDoors: scene names of the entrance door leaves that stay shut. They close toward each other and open back to the pose they have in the scene.
conversation: hearts per finished plaza client conversation (bonus), and how many clients there are.
sideQuest: full EXP and hearts for a perfect corkboard; expPerWrong is taken off per wrong placement; a heart is lost at each count in heartsLostAtWrong (e.g. 1, 3, 5 wrong).

Badge tiers: finishing the side quest always earns the badge. Side Quest 1's tier is its corkboard's FIRST check (ClassificationCheck, 2026-10-27): Gold = 4/4, Silver = 2/4 (one swapped pair; one card per corner, so 3/4 cannot happen), Bronze = 0-1/4. Replays keep the best tier.
badgeEmblem: the medal's centre picture (taxpayer_id, receipt, star). badgeRibbon: the ribbon colour (#RRGGBB). Give each side quest its own.

caseFile: full EXP and hearts per case for a first-try, mistake-free audit; per mistake the Auditor finds, and per extra submission (going back to redo), the amounts below are taken off. wrongVerdictExp: EXP for a case finished without an audit whose verdict was wrong.

The level score never goes above its maximum: bonuses (e.g. plaza conversation hearts; on-time submission adds none) only win back lost points. Out-of-range numbers are clamped when the level loads and the Console names each one.
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.
